plugin.name: Kitchen Cabinet Designer
dialog.title: Kitchen Cabinet Designer
command.open.status: Create parametric base and wall kitchen cabinets.
command.edit.status: Load the selected cabinet into the designer to change its parameters.
hint.height_base: Carcass height, excluding legs and countertop.
hint.depth: Carcass depth including the back panel, excluding fronts.
hint.plinth_height: Floor to the underside of the carcass.
hint.elevation: Additional lift of the whole cabinet (e.g. on a podium).
hint.mount_height: Floor to the underside of the wall cabinet.
hint.wall_gap: Gap between the cabinet back and the wall.
msg.no_selection: Select exactly one cabinet created by Kitchen Cabinet Designer.
msg.target_lost: The cabinet being edited no longer exists. Select it again and press Load Selected.
msg.copies:
This cabinet has %{count} copies in the model.

Yes - update all copies
No - update only the selected cabinet
Cancel - do nothing
msg.outside_sketchup: This page must be opened from SketchUp (Extensions > Kitchen Cabinet Designer).
error.type_category: %{type} is not available for this category (%{category}).
error.not_implemented: Not implemented yet: %{type}. This cabinet type is planned for a later version.
error.width_thickness: Width is too small for the panel thickness (minimum %{min} mm).
error.height_thickness: Height is too small for the panel thickness (minimum %{min} mm).
error.back_depth: The back panel position leaves less than %{min} mm of usable carcass depth.
error.geometry: Geometry could not be created: %{message} The operation was cancelled; the model is unchanged.
error.internal: Unexpected error: %{message} See the Ruby Console for details.
hint.back_inset: Distance from the rear edge of the carcass to the back panel. 0 with a groove = rebate.
hint.groove_play: Clearance between the back panel edge and the bottom of the groove.
hint.groove_extra_width: Groove width = back thickness + this value.
hint.shelf_front_setback: Distance from the carcass front edge (or from the back of inset doors) to the shelf front edge.
hint.plinth_setback: Distance from the carcass front edge to the plinth board.
hint.middle_legs_from: Adds a middle pair of legs for cabinets at least this wide. 0 = never.
hint.hanging_rail: Rail behind the back panel, under the top panel. Needs back inset or wall gap of at least the rail thickness.
error.groove_depth: Groove depth must leave at least 3 mm of panel material (maximum %{max} mm).
error.groove_play: Groove play must be smaller than the groove depth.
error.rails_overlap: Rails overlap: each rail may be at most %{max} mm wide for this depth.
error.shelves: Too many shelves: the gap between shelves would be %{value} mm (minimum %{min} mm).
error.shelf_depth: Shelf front setback leaves less than %{min} mm of shelf depth.
error.plinth_required: Plinth / legs height must be at least %{min} mm for the selected supports (or choose None).
error.plinth_depth: The plinth board does not fit in the cabinet depth: reduce the setback or thickness.
error.legs_side: Legs stick out of the cabinet: the side offset must be at least the leg radius (%{min} mm).
error.legs_width: Legs collide across the width: reduce the leg diameter or the side offset.
error.legs_front: Front legs collide with the plinth board: front offset must be at least %{min} mm.
error.legs_depth: Legs do not fit in the cabinet depth: check the front/back offsets and the leg diameter.
error.rail_height: Hanging rail is too tall for this cabinet (maximum %{max} mm).
error.rail_fit: Hanging rail does not fit behind the back panel: needs %{need} mm, available %{available} mm. Use an inset back panel or increase the distance from the wall.
warn.groove_wall: Only %{value} mm of material remains behind the groove.
hint.edge_gaps: Gap from the front edge to the cabinet outline. 1 mm per side gives 2 mm between neighbouring cabinets.
hint.front_extend: Lets overlay fronts run past the carcass, e.g. to hide a wall cabinet's underside.
hint.inset_setback: How far inset fronts are set back from the carcass front edge.
hint.drawer_heights: Millimetres separated by ";". 0 or empty = share the remaining height equally. Example: 140; 0; 0
hint.drawer_box_depth: 0 = automatic: the longest standard slide length (step 50 mm) that fits.
hint.slide_depth_clearance: The box depth is at most the carcass depth minus this value.
error.front_below_floor: The extended fronts would go below the floor.
error.inset_depth: Inset fronts are set back too far into the carcass.
error.door_small: Doors would be smaller than %{min} mm. Increase the cabinet size or reduce the gaps.
warn.wide_door: A single door %{width} mm wide is unusually wide; consider two doors.
error.drawer_heights_format: Front heights: enter numbers separated by ";" (e.g. 140; 0; 0).
error.drawer_heights_count: Front heights: %{given} values given for %{count} drawers.
error.drawer_heights_sum: Front heights add up to %{sum} mm but must add up to %{expected} mm. Use 0 for automatic heights.
error.drawer_front_small: A drawer front would be %{value} mm high (minimum %{min} mm).
error.drawer_width: Drawer boxes are too narrow for the slide clearance and side thickness (inner width under %{min} mm).
error.drawer_depth: Drawer box is too deep: maximum %{max} mm for this carcass.
error.drawer_depth_small: Drawer boxes would be shallower than %{min} mm.
error.drawer_box_tall: Drawer %{index}: box height is too large (maximum %{max} mm). Use 0 for automatic.
error.drawer_box_low: Drawer %{index}: the box would be only %{value} mm high (minimum %{min} mm). Make this front taller or reduce the box gaps.
label.preview_unavailable: Preview unavailable: correct the highlighted fields.
msg.close_edit_context: Close the cabinet's edit context first (press Esc or click outside it), then press Update Selected again.
hint.blind_width: Part of the front covered by the neighbouring cabinet run. Measured from the cabinet's outer side to the middle of the gap.
error.corner_split: The blind panel and the door must each be at least %{min} mm wide: adjust the blind panel width.
msg.category_change: This is a %{category}. Switch the category back to update it, or press Stop editing and create a new cabinet.
hint.materials: Click a swatch to choose a colour, texture or a material from the model.
material.model_empty: The model has no materials yet.
error.material: %{field}: invalid material (unknown preset, bad colour or a name longer than %{max} characters).
msg.language_restart: Menu and toolbar texts change after SketchUp is restarted.
hint.back_offset: Overlay back only: distance from the carcass outline to the back panel edge, so the back is not visible from the side.
hint.edges: Edge banding thickness, 0 = none. Used for the cut list: edges of 1 mm and more are subtracted from the cut size.
hint.export: Creates two files for Excel or cutting software: the cut list (sizes, cut sizes, edges, grain) and the estimate (sheets, edge metres, hardware, price columns).
library.empty: No own materials yet. Load a texture image (e.g. a decor downloaded from the board manufacturer) or add a colour by its code.
library.choose_folder: Choose a folder with texture images
library.bad_image: The file could not be added. Use a JPG, PNG, BMP or TIF image.
library.empty_folder: No images (JPG, PNG, BMP, TIF) found in this folder.
library.hint: Saved on this computer and available in every model. Texture size: 1000 mm per image.
msg.export_empty: No cabinets to export (select cabinets or choose all cabinets in the model).
error.export_option: Export settings: values must be between %{min} and %{max}.
report.edge_note: Cut size = finished size minus edge banding of %{min} mm or more. L1/L2 = long edges, W1/W2 = short edges.
report.price_note: Enter prices in the Price column; sums are calculated automatically.
